401911020.headline: Bryant vs. UMass prediction: model has UMass by 15
paragraphs: Bryant (1-4) visits UMass at Mullins Center in Amherst Tuesday at 7:30 PM ET on ESPN+.

Our model makes UMass a 15.4-point favorite, projecting a 73-58 final, and gives UMass a 90% chance to win. The betting market has UMass favored by 11.5 with a total of 139.5. The model leans UMass -11.5 and Under 139.5.
Players to watch: Keegan Harvey of Bryant, 11.5 points a game; Roi Behar of Bryant, 8.6 points a game; Andre Pasha of Bryant, 7.2 points a game.

asides.text: My lean is Bryant by effort; UMass might have the bigger name, but effort does not care about names.
asides.name: Marcus Bell
